question: Your organization maintains an internal service registry that lists the endpoints exposed by various teams across the organization. Endpoints are added and removed throughout the day. Your team uses Antigravity to write client code against the endpoints. You discover that the agent is generating code referencing stale, decommissioned endpoints. You need Antigravity to dynamically verify active endpoints from the registry in real time while generating code. What should you do? A. Create an MCP server, and connect Antigravity to the registry using the MCP. B. Define a custom Antigravity subagent whose role is endpoint lookup. C. Add the endpoint list to an Antigravity workspace rule. D. Add an Antigravity PostToolUse hook that checks generated calls against the registry.
